name: Our Lady and St Joseph, Heywood

boundary.description: From the point where Bury, Rossendale and Rochdale District boundaries meet, near Birtle Edge Farm, along Rossendale – Rochdale boundary to Cheesden Brook, E through Cleggs Wood and Black Dad Wood, by a beeline to the junction of Ashworth Road and School Lane,S along Ashworth Road, E along Bury and Rochdale Old Road and S along Queen’s Park Road to River Roch to the point opposite Matthew Moss High School on Bolton Road (A58), and by a bee-line to and SW along Bolton Road, then by a footpath going through Francil, Heys Farm to the Heywood railway, E by that railway to, and W along the M62 Motorway to Whittle Brook, then by that brook and Bury – Rochdale District boundary N to M66 Motorway junction 3. N by the motorway to junction 2 and by Bury – Rochdale District boundary W, NW to the point where it meets Rossendale District boundary.
